# Maintainer

[Martin Calander](https://martincalander.com) maintains the importer, reviews changes, publishes releases, and handles security reports.

For normal questions, please use the channels in [SUPPORT.md](https://github.com/martincalander/com.martincalander.blockbenchimporter/blob/main/.github/SUPPORT.md). For a vulnerability, follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/martincalander/com.martincalander.blockbenchimporter/blob/main/.github/SECURITY.md) or email `martin.calander@gmail.com`.
